title: CodeGuard: Improving LLM Guardrails in CS Education
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and benchmarking a guardrail framework (CodeGuard) based on academic integrity and ethical conduct. Its taxonomy specifically includes ethical and moral violation categories such as 'Hate / Discriminatory Automation' and 'Illicit-Activity Facilitation,' and it evaluates model performance in detecting these breaches of ethical codes derived from university syllabi.
